title: Cosmic Horse Painter
description: A majestic brown horse wearing glasses and a black kimono with a kanji symbol sits on a stone platform in space, painting with a brush on an open book. Surrounding the horse is a vibrant cosmic scene with a black hole eclipse, colorful swirling galaxies, floating golden koi fish, lotus flowers, a skeletal dragon, and ethereal flowing ribbons of color.
prompt: A majestic brown horse with glasses wearing a black kimono sits cross-legged on a stone platform floating in outer space, holding a paintbrush and painting in an open book, vibrant swirling galaxy and black hole with red eclipse in the background, golden koi fish swimming through the air, colorful ethereal ribbons and flowers flowing around, skeletal dragon and lotus flowers on the reflective platform below, highly detailed surreal fantasy scene
